transfer.title: Confirm the request to take over this site's service?

“{company}” has asked Hauflo support to hand this site's service over to it.

If you own this site and asked for it, choose “Yes”: your confirmation is attached to the request. Nothing changes now: Hauflo support decides after telling the previous company (usually in 14 days). independent.title: Make the site independent
independent.description:
What happens:
- The Hauflo dashboard cards are copied to /config/www/hauflo and added as dashboard resources, so the family's dashboard works without the agent.
- Every enabled Hauflo alarm rule is brought up to date as an ordinary automation `hauflo_alarm_…` in automations.yaml: the same sensors and alarm states, a push to the same Home Assistant app phones (critical where the rule is), a notification in HA and the rule's button. A backup copy of automations.yaml is made first. An automation edited by hand is left as it is.
- Nothing is deleted. The alarm automations keep working after the integration is removed.

What stops working once Hauflo is removed:
- Cloud monitoring: “agent offline”, “KNX bus silent”, the monitoring page and the service company's view.
- Telegram alarms and the alarm history in Hauflo.
- Deploys and updates from the project, guest links, “Away” presence simulation, voice sentences, editing the family's automations and scenes on the dashboard (the ones already made keep running).

Submit to do it.

options.air_handler: Air handler: its air is not the room's
options.coarse_battery: The battery reports its level in coarse steps
options.no_norm: No norm of its own — a limit is needed

options.small_gap: Skipped: too close to the target
options.long: Skipped: target not reached within a day

options.floor_rate: Check the loop's balancing at the manifold (flow), the actuator's opening and the supply temperature.
options.floor_warmup: Slow to reach the setpoint: check supply and pump, balancing; for a slow screed — PWM or weather-compensated supply.
options.floor_overshoot: Overshoots the setpoint: a slow screed — lower the hysteresis or use PWM, lower the supply temperature.
options.floor_duty: The loop runs almost non-stop: not enough supply or power — check balancing and the pump.
options.radiator_rate: Check the radiator's balancing valve, the thermostatic head/actuator, air in it, the supply.
options.radiator_warmup: Slow to reach the setpoint: check the valve actuator, the supply, air in the radiator.
options.radiator_overshoot: Overshoots the setpoint: check the hysteresis and the sensor's place (not next to the radiator).
options.radiator_duty: Runs almost non-stop: not enough power — check the supply and balancing.
options.ac_rate: Slow to reach the mode: check filters, the coil, the refrigerant charge, the unit's capacity for the room.
options.ac_warmup: Slow to reach the mode: filters, refrigerant charge, fan speed, the unit's capacity.
options.ac_overshoot: Overcools/overheats past the setpoint: check the hysteresis and the sensor's place.
options.ac_cycles: The compressor starts too often: the unit is oversized or the hysteresis too small — check the settings.
options.ahu_cycles: Heating/cooling stages chatter: raise the hysteresis or the stage delay, check the supply air sensor.
options.ahu_duty: Supply air heated/cooled almost non-stop: check the heating medium, the coil valve, the supply setpoint.
options.boiler_cycles: Burner short cycles: check the minimum output and modulation, the hysteresis, the flow (pump, bypass).
options.boiler_warmup: Slow to reach the temperature: check the output, modulation, the flow.
options.boiler_tank_rate: The tank heats slowly: check the hot-water priority, the charging pump, scale on the coil.
options.boiler_tank_warmup: The tank takes long to heat: hot-water priority, charging pump, medium temperature, scale.
options.humidifier_rate: Slow to raise the humidity: check the water, the cartridge/nozzles, its capacity for the room.
options.humidifier_warmup: Slow to reach the humidity setpoint: water, cartridge, capacity, dry supply air.
options.humidifier_overshoot: Overshoots the humidity: check the hysteresis and the sensor's place.
options.humidifier_duty: Runs almost non-stop: not enough capacity, or the sensor is off.
options.valve_cycles: The valve switches too often: raise the hysteresis or the PWM period, check the sensor.

options.loop_slow: Loop heats slower than its peers
options.corr_vent_humidity: Extract fan on, humidity not falling

options.climate: While the thermostat wants heat (or cold), I watch how fast the room's temperature moves towards the setpoint. The norm is this room's own speed from its past episodes. If the temperature has hardly moved for much longer than usual, I say so. Paused while a window or door of the room is open, off-season, and when the setpoint changes.
options.stuck: A temperature or humidity sensor normally changes many times a day. I learn how often this one changes; if it stays at one value far longer than usual, it has probably frozen or lost power.
options.battery: I follow the battery level over the days and forecast when it runs out, so it can be replaced in advance.
options.link: I follow the radio signal of the device over the days; a steady drop means it will soon drop off.
options.host: I follow the free disk space of the house's server and the age of its last backup.
options.slowing: From each heating (cooling) episode I keep its speed; if recent episodes are clearly slower than this room's usual at a similar outdoor temperature, the heating is losing power (filter, valve, pump).
options.cycling: I count how often the equipment starts per hour. The norm is its own usual; far more starts than usual wear it out.
options.flapping: I count how often the device goes offline per day. The norm is its own usual.
options.water: I watch water use at night, when nobody uses water. A steady night flow above the usual is a likely leak.
options.noeffect: When the device is on, the reading it drives should change within a set time (for example the floor gets warmer). If it is on and nothing changes, I say so. Paused while a window is open and off-season.
options.series: I learn this reading's usual values by time of day and day of week (and season, where it matters) and say when it stays far outside them.
options.correlation: After the device switches on, the linked reading should move (consumption appears, CO₂ or humidity falls). I learn by how much it usually moves; if it does not, I say so.
options.loops: I compare this loop with similar loops of the house: speed, time to reach the setpoint, overshoot, starts per day, share of time running. Clearly worse than its peers = worth a look.

off_in.name: Switch off after a time
off_in.description: Turns a light off after the given minutes (0 cancels). Kept until Home Assistant restarts.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Minutes until it is switched off; 0 cancels.

unprotect.name: Remove gate protection
unprotect.description: For Home Assistant's admin only (Hauflo's cloud can't call it). A KNX entity Hauflo once saw as a gate, garage door or door, and the group addresses that open it, stay protected from scenes, voice assistants, guest links and Hauflo's changes even after its class changed. Clears that for the chosen entities or addresses; one still a gate / garage door / door by its class is protected again at once.

group_address.name: Group addresses
group_address.description: Addresses to clear (e.g. 7/7/1), for an entity already deleted.

remove_alarms.name: Remove Hauflo alarms
remove_alarms.description: For Home Assistant's admin only (Hauflo's cloud can't call it). Removes every alarm automation “Alarm: …” and helper “Hauflo · accepted: …” Hauflo made, edited ones too; the Hauflo agent sends the alarms itself again until the next project is applied.

intercom_answer.name: Answer the intercom call
intercom_answer.description: Answers the call: the person who answered talks, everyone else sees "Answered on another device". The sound goes through the door's "Talk" camera.

entity_id.name: Intercom
entity_id.description: Any entity of the door (intercom, call, camera, button).

intercom_hangup.name: End the intercom call
intercom_hangup.description: Declines the ring or ends the call. Only an admin ends someone else's call.

entity_id.name: Intercom
entity_id.description: Any entity of the door (intercom, call, camera, button).

lock.name: Lock / unlock / open the door
lock.description: The panel's lock buttons: locking is always allowed; unlocking or opening — only by the people chosen in the lock's settings (none chosen — anyone).

action.name: Action
action.description: lock, unlock or open (open — only a lock that can open the door).
